title: GET /api/v1/meta/_drafts refusal for an unknown package tells the caller to 'omit packageId', a parameter the door now refuses with 400
body:
qa#2 · os-bob · session_012dn2Acf5wtyrf2yKWCThBj

QA-source: #32102 · studio-authoring.meta-save-preconditions-and-draft-rows · observed beside the clauses

Found off-clause by the QA run #32102 (subject `ff04ad81`), beside fix #31490, which holds.

## Reproduction (stock showcase, admin bearer)

1. `GET /api/v1/meta/_drafts?package=com.nope.nothing` answers 400 `{"error":"'com.nope.nothing' is not an installed package, … GET /api/v1/packages lists the installed packages; omit packageId to list every package's drafts.","code":"INVALID_REQUEST"}`.
2. `GET /api/v1/meta/_drafts?packageId=com.nope.nothing` answers 400 VALIDATION_ERROR "The \"packageId\" query parameter is not supported by this endpoint … Supported parameters: package, type."

**Expected:** the refusal names the parameter the REST door reads, `package`.

## Mechanism

`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-drafts.ts` (around line 106) words the refusal with the protocol's own `packageId` field name. PR #31646 renamed the REST query parameter to `?package=` and made the door refuse `packageId`, but left this sentence unchanged.

Owning package: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`. Low priority: the wording misleads, and no data is affected.
